title.text: Meet Treehouse. <break time="0.7s" /> Because we think every coding agent needs its own space.

worktrees.text: Each chat runs a Pi agent in its own git worktree, so agents never step on each other's changes.

approval.text: Nothing runs without you. Commands wait until you run, always allow, or deny them.

subagents.text: Pi can hand side quests to sub-agents. Open one to follow along, steer it, or stop it.

diff.text: When the work is done, review each worktree's changes, unified or side by side.

trust.text: New projects start read-only, until you choose to trust them.

end.text: Treehouse. Open source, and built in Rust.
